summary: Iteration 39: Smart Cache (24h TTL) and Opportunity Alerts System Testing Complete. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend features verified: Notification bell visible in Header, dropdown opens on click, Radar LMR tab with stats and individual analysis working. Critical filter toggle added (only visible when total > 0).

VERIFIED: Smart cache TTL is 24 hours (ttl_hours: 24.0)
VERIFIED: GET /api/dama/lmr-analysis first call is MISS, second call is HIT

VERIFIED: GET /api/anvisa/buscar-medicamento uses smart cache with 'anvisa_busca' namespace
VERIFIED: POST /api/cache/clear clears both search_cache and smart_cache (active_entries becomes 0)
VERIFIED: GET /api/notificacoes/oportunidades returns alertas array, total, nao_lidas
VERIFIED: POST /api/notificacoes/oportunidades/{id}/lida returns 404 for nonexistent ID
VERIFIED: POST /api/dama/prova-documental with analise_lmr returns PDF with LMR tax analysis section
VERIFIED: Frontend notification bell (data-testid=notificacao-bell) visible in Header
VERIFIED: Frontend clicking bell opens dropdown (data-testid=notificacao-dropdown)
VERIFIED: Frontend Radar LMR tab (data-testid=tab-radar-lmr) visible and functional
VERIFIED: Frontend RadarLmrTab individual analysis form works with classification, tax strategy, margin analysis

FIXED: Added critical filter toggle (data-testid=toggle-so-criticas) to RadarLmrTab - only visible when oportunidades.total > 0

NOTE: Critical filter toggle not visible because oportunidades.total = 0 (expected behavior per design)

The critical filter toggle only appears when oportunidades.total > 0.
